import pandas as pd

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Standardize species names (case/typo variants)
    species_map = {
        "adelie": "Adelie",
        "adeli": "Adelie",  # just in case
        "chinstrap": "Chinstrap",
        "gentoo": "Gentoo",
        "gentto": "Gentoo"
    }
    # lower‑case, strip spaces and map
    df["species"] = df["species"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().map(species_map).fillna(df["species"])

    # Ensure flipper_length_mm is numeric
    df["flipper_length_mm"] = pd.to_numeric(df["flipper_length_mm"], errors="coerce")
    # Apply valid range (170‑235) – values outside become NaN
    df.loc[~df["flipper_length_mm"].between(170, 235), "flipper_length_mm"] = pd.NA

    return df

def answer(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    # Compute average flipper length per species, ignoring NaN values
    result = (
        df.groupby("species", dropna=True)["flipper_length_mm"]
        .mean()
        .round(2)
        .to_dict()
    )
    return result
